args.title: Remember the last used export format
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Enhance the ExportButton component to store the last used export format in local storage. This way, when users return to the page, the export format they last used is pre-selected, reducing the chance of accidental exports in the wrong format.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component should be enhanced to remember the last used export format by storing it in local storage. This would allow the export format to be pre-selected when the user returns to the page, minimizing errors.
